About SirenOpt 

 At SirenOpt®, we are building the manufacturing intelligence layer for advanced materials. We help manufacturers visualize, understand, and control the material behavior that determines yield, performance, and safety across energy, aerospace, automotive, electronics, and semiconductor applications.   

 We are working on this problem because advanced materials are becoming more critical and more complex, but the tools used to manufacture them have not kept pace. Manufacturers still lack real-time visibility into the small variations that shape quality on the line. We care because those invisible variations cause scrap, waste energy and materials, create higher costs, inconsistent product performance, and introduce avoidable safety risks.   

 We developed PlasmaSens™, our manufacturing intelligence platform, to close that visibility gap and to lay the foundation for truly autonomous manufacturing.   

 We are uniquely suited to solve this problem because our expertise and our platform connect material science, plasma physics, machine learning, and manufacturing in one system.  The same core technology works in-line, at-line, and off-line, and across form factors ranging from electrodes and wafers to 3D components. That flexibility lets us meet manufacturers where they are and carry insight from the lab into mass production.   

 We have deployed multiple PlasmaSens products with customers and collaborators across the United States, Japan, Germany, and Taiwan.  We pair that real-world experience with support from leading US, European, and Japanese venture investors, the National Science Foundation, the California Energy Commission, and the Department of Energy.  Our combination of differentiated technology, manufacturing experience, and global scientific and industry partnerships gives us the foundation to solve material variability at scale.   

 About the job 

 Job Title: Software Engineer (Early Career) – C++ & Systems

 Location: On-Site (San Leandro, CA)

 Job Type: Full-Time

 Role Overview 

 SirenOpt is seeking a Software Engineer to help build and maintain the real-time data pipeline behind our sensing platform: acquiring data from multiple sensors, processing and storing it on Linux-based systems, and delivering it to the applications our customers rely on. 

 You will work primarily in modern C++ and Python, with mentorship from senior engineers, and you will be hands-on with real hardware in our lab to test and validate what you build. This is a role for someone who wants to grow into a well-rounded systems engineer by shipping production software end to end, from a first design discussion to a feature running at a customer site. 

 What You'll Do 

 
 Develop and maintain software components in modern C++ (C++17/20) for Linux-based systems, with guidance from senior engineers 

 Implement features, fix bugs, and write unit and integration tests across the data pipeline, from sensor acquisition through processing and storage to the services that deliver results to applications 

 Write and maintain Python scripts for automation, testing, and data analysis 

 Read, and where needed modify, existing code written in other languages across our codebase 

 Use AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, and verify their output through testing, profiling, and code review 

 Run the system on real hardware in the lab to test and validate your changes, including setting up sensors and collecting data 

 Participate in code reviews, both receiving and giving feedback, and follow team conventions for code quality 

 Help diagnose and debug issues across software and hardware boundaries, working with firmware and hardware engineers 

 Measure and improve performance of existing code under the direction of senior engineers

 Document your work so that others on the team can build on it

 
 What We're Looking For 

 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field (recent graduates welcome) 

 0–2 years of professional software development experience; internships, co-ops, research, and substantial personal or open-source projects count 

 Solid foundation in C++, including memory management, references and pointers, the standard library, and basic object-oriented and generic programming 

 Strong ability to read, understand, and write Python, including working within existing Python codebases used for automation, testing, and data analysis 

 Ability to pick up new programming languages quickly; our codebase spans several languages and you will need to read, and occasionally modify, code outside of C++ and Python 

 Understanding of core computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and concurrency basics 

 Comfortable with the everyday toolchain: Linux command line, build tools (CMake or similar), a debugger, and Git-based workflows (branches, pull requests, code review) 

 Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as part of a real development workflow, and the judgment to review and test what they produce 

 Comfortable working hands-on with lab and test equipment: setting up sensors, running the system on real hardware, and collecting data for testing and validation (we will train you on our specific equipment) 

 Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work well with teammates across disciplines

 
 Nice to have: 

 
 Experience with Qt, gRPC, or Protocol Buffers 

 Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing 

 Experience with profiling and debugging tools such as perf, Valgrind, GDB, or sanitizers 

 Familiarity with hardware communication interfaces such as Ethernet, USB, or Serial 

 Contributions to open-source projects 

 
 What You'll Learn 

 You will work on a real-time sensing platform that is already running at some of the largest manufacturers in the world, on a small team where your code reaches customers quickly.

 
 How a high-throughput, multi-sensor data pipeline is built end to end, from acquisition through processing and storage, and kept reliable in production

 Modern C++ and Linux systems engineering, with regular code review and mentorship from senior engineers

 How software, firmware, and hardware teams work together to ship a physical product

 How to use AI coding tools effectively and responsibly in a professional engineering workflow

 A clear path to grow into a mid-level engineer with ownership of your own components

 Base Pay Range
 $120,000 — $160,000 USD 


 Benefits 

 
 Equity and Salary compensation depends on experience 

 Health, Dental, Vision plans provided

 401k matching provided

 Time off: 20 days of PTO per year, plus approximately 15 paid US holidays per year
